_about: TRIAL (far-side seats rig, never for main). What the rig lays over the wider chart on the first day, read by src/campaign/world.ts at attach. 'held': a province held on 1 September 1939 by another than its owner (baked from the clerk's held_1939 column by tools/trial/bake-held.mjs). 'capitals': a capital that moves once the whole homeland is on the chart. 'drop': first-day corps rows a seats file replaces, [nation, name]. 'wars': wars standing on the first day. Every seats file's 'setup' block is laid over this file when the rig is built (tools/trial/seats.mjs).
